title: Vibecoding: A Smart-Driving Collection Business System in 2 Days
title_zh: Vibecoding · 2天速成智驾采集业务系统
excerpt: Build a working, deployable business system for an autonomous-driving data collection fleet in about two days: a 10,340-line single-file FastAPI backend, 240 APIs, 53 tables, and dual-end React SPAs — then keep shipping through V1.9.
excerpt_zh: 用 Vibecoding 在约 2 天内跑通一套能上线的智驾数据采集车队管理系统：10,340 行单文件 FastAPI 后端、240 个接口、53 张表、双端 React SPA，并在此后持续迭代到 V1.9。

title: MapXAI — Map Designer Agent
title_zh: 地图XAI · 地图设计师智能体
excerpt: Describe a map style in one sentence, and the AI generates the map style operations (ops) and drives the map engine to render it; sessions, history, and finished styles are kept as reusable product assets.
excerpt_zh: 用一句话描述想要的地图样式，AI 即生成地图样式操作（ops）并驱动地图引擎渲染出成品；会话、对话历史与成品风格沉淀为可复用的产品资产。

title: MapXAI · Future Map Solutions Collection
title_zh: 地图XAI · 未来地图解决方案收录
excerpt: A Map × AI industry solution atlas that systematically collects, showcases, and evaluates frontier solutions in the future-map space, turning them into understandable, comparable, decision-ready assets.
excerpt_zh: 一个「地图 × AI 行业解决方案图谱」平台，系统化搜集、展示与评测未来地图方向的前沿方案，沉淀为可理解、可对比、可决策的信息资产。

title: Product Manager XAI · How to Achieve "Electricity-Water Freedom" with Minimal Effort
title_zh: 产品经理XAI · 如何最小化实现水电自由
excerpt: Run an LLM locally on your own machine — pay once, trade electricity for token fees, and drive AI's marginal cost toward zero: a few hundred lines of stdlib Python turn a 1B model into a local engine that streams chat and serves as an API.
excerpt_zh: 在自己机器上本地运行大模型，一次采购、电费换 Token 费，把 AI 的边际成本趋近于零——几百行标准库 Python 把 1B 模型跑成可流式对话、可当作 API 的本地引擎。
